Die Sendereihe stellt Österreich als Heimat und Lebensraum in seiner regionalen Vielfalt vor. Zu den Themen zählen Kultur, Geschichte und Tradition, insbesondere regionale und volkskulturelle Entwicklungen.

pr.t: Gefiederte Nachbarn - Die bunte Welt der Gartenvögel
pr.d: Geheime Dramen, raffinierte Überlebensstrategien und starke Persönlichkeiten zeigen sich unter den Vögeln in der täuschend idyllischen Kulisse eines Gartens in Klagenfurt. Durch die Jahreszeiten wetteifern Singvögel miteinander um Nahrungsquellen.

Turmfalken sind die erfolgreichsten Greifvögel Europas. Sie sind anpassungsfähige Bewohner von Au-Gebieten ebenso wie von alpinen Regionen. Außerdem sind sie wahrlich meisterhafte Jäger. Die Dokumentation begleitet zwei Brutpaare.

Im Märchen treten Frösche immer in denselben Rollen auf. In Wirklichkeit ist die Amphibienwelt aber um einiges vielfältiger. Zu dieser Welt zählen der tödliche Pfeilgiftfrosch und der Darwinfrosch, der mit verblüffenden Methoden für Nachwuchs sorgt. Der Film lädt ein zu einer Entdeckungsreise in die verborgene Welt der Amphibien und zeigt diese oft verkannten Tiere und ihre faszinierende Lebensweise in ihrer ganzen Bandbreite.

Die Libelle, auch Wasserjungfer genannt, bewohnt die Erde schon seit dem Zeitalter der Dinosaurier. Das Insekt lebt vorzugsweise in wasserreichen Gegenden. Doch sein Lebensraum schrumpft, und so sind allein in Europa heute etwa 80 Libellenarten akut vom Aussterben bedroht. Die Dokumentation macht mit Entwicklung und Lebensweise dieses in metallischen Farben leuchtenden Räubers bekannt.

pr.t: Im Reich von Kreuzotter & Co. - Österreichs Schlangen hautnah
pr.d: Schlangenangst ist sehr tief in jedem Menschen verankert. Ein Jahr lang hat man sich diesen Tieren "hautnah" angenähert und ist den Schlangen Österreichs auf der Spur. Es werden sechs verschiedene Schlangenarten vorgestellt.

Es ist das Wasser aus den Alpen, das Österreich geprägt hat. Schnee und Gletscher versorgen unzählige Bäche, Flüsse und Bäche, die seit jeher fruchtbare Täler geformt und reichhaltige Lebensräume für Pflanzen und Tiere geschaffen haben.

Eine Reise in unbekannte, wilde Welten: Wasser ist nicht nur die Grundlage alles Lebens, es hat Österreich auch einige der spektakulärsten Naturwunder Europas geschenkt. Der Film begibt sich auf deren Spuren.
Die Dokumentationsreihe stellt die schönsten und interessantesten Seiten Österreichs vor.

Vom Salzhandelsplatz bis zur nationalsozialistischen Hauptstadt der Bewegung ist die Geschichte Münchens vielfältig. Wir begeben uns auf eine Zeitreise durch die Geschichte der bayerischen Stadt, die für viele der Inbegriff von "Heimat" ist.

Eine Zeitreise durch die Hauptstadt zeigt Berlins spannende Geschichte. Sie beginnt im Nikolaiviertel, der Wiege Berlins, und führt bis zum Berliner Schloss, dem Ort, an dem sich die dramatische Geschichte Berlins verdichtet.

Die Geschichte der Hansestadt spannt von den Anfängen als einfacher Handelsposten bis zur Blütezeit als pulsierende Hafenmetropole. Mirko Drotschmann trifft Menschen, deren persönliche Geschichten eng mit der Entwicklung Hamburgs verbunden sind.

In der goldenen Ära des Orient-Express können Reisende mit nur einem Ticket von London bis Istanbul reisen. Unterwegs warten Städte voller Geschichte. Es geht mit der Fähre nach Frankreich, wo eine Nacht in Paris auf die Passagiere wartet.

Die zweite Etappe der Reise führt von Paris nach Salzburg. Sie erzählt vom Glanz und von den Abgründen des Orient-Express: Luxusdesign und Automobilvisionen. Das Filmteam folgt der historischen Strecke von Paris durch Süddeutschland und Österreich.

Auf den Spuren des Orient-Express von München über Wien geht es weiter nach Budapest. Diese Etappe vereint Ingenieurskunst und politische Geschichte. Das Filmteam folgt der historischen Strecke über den Semmering nach Wien und weiter nach Budapest.

Die letzte Etappe führt nach Istanbul, das historische Ziel des Orient-Express und der krönende Abschluss dieser einzigartigen Zugreise. Auf dem Weg in die Türkei geht es quer durch Bulgarien, vorbei an Sofia und Plowdiw.

Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

Anthony Archer-Wills is the Pete Nelson of pool design. Nelson stars in Animal Planet's popular `Treehouse Masters', creating hideaways in the limbs of oaks and maples. Archer-Wills works on the ground as a world-renowned builder of swimming pools but uses the same creativity and respect for ecology. In `The Pool Master', the charming Brit has unfaltering enthusiasm for his work - rivaled only by his love of a cool gin and tonic. He designs and executes unique and stunning pools that seem to be formed by nature. His goal is "to support the environment, provide homes to beds of aquatic plants, and foster elements of mystery," which enhance the experience of swimming.

People who know and work with Pete Nelson describe him as a tree whisperer. For his part, Nelson lets the trees do the talking. He's a world-renowned treehouse designer and builder, and this series documents the work he and his team of craftsmen - including his son Charlie - do to create incredible homes and businesses in nature's canopy. Pete uses a combination of science and art to realize clients' sky-high aspirations of magnificent multibedroom treehouses with elaborate kitchens and bathrooms, or simpler, peaceful one-room escapes. `Pit Bulls and Parolees' follows the work of Tia Torres, a renowned pit bull trainer and founder of the Villalobos Rescue Center. The rehabilitation and placement centre houses hundreds of abused and abandoned dogs of all breeds, and the centre has a crew of paroled felons who help Torres and her daughters Tania and Mariah care for the animals. It is a chance at redemption for both man and man's best friend.

Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

Animal Planet expands its family of wildlife law enforcement series, adding to Maine's `North Woods Law' an offering that follows an elite patrol force in Texas. `Lone Star Law' features the men and women of the Texas Game Wardens who protect more than a quarter-million square miles of deserts, lakes, piney woods, bayous, plains and coast in the second-largest state in the US. Whether rushing to investigate poaching cases, save flash-flood victims, disrupt illegal smuggling rings, or rescue injured wildlife, the officers are always on the go, defending both animals and citizens.

British actor Richard E. Grant presents a natural history series focusing on the seven deadly sins and their presence in human and animal behaviour. The history of the capital vices is explored through their use in the literature of noted writers such as Dante Alighieri and William Shakespeare. As well as Grant viewing the sins from a human perspective, scientists identify these traits within the animal kingdom and apply them to what they believe are survival instincts. Episodes show wildlife footage of envious lions and wrathful hippopotamuses in action.

For four generations the Kilchers have lived off what their 600-acre homestead has provided, but cultivating that living is never easy. The brothers-in-law, best friends and business partners operate Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the biggest aquarium-building manufacturer in the US. `Tanked' showcases the guys, their family members who also work at ATM and the shop's crew as they create over-the-top aquariums for a wide array of clients, both celebrities and regular folks. The dedicated team at the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals, a private charity, respond to a variety of distress calls involving an average of more than 100 animals per day. This series documents the work they do, from the initial investigation through, in some cases, the animals being adopted into loving homes.

Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

`Pit Bulls and Parolees' follows the work of Tia Torres, a renowned pit bull trainer and founder of the Villalobos Rescue Center. The rehabilitation and placement centre houses hundreds of abused and abandoned dogs of all breeds, and the centre has a crew of paroled felons who help Torres and her daughters Tania and Mariah care for the animals. It is a chance at redemption for both man and man's best friend.

Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

Animal Planet expands its family of wildlife law enforcement series, adding to Maine's `North Woods Law' an offering that follows an elite patrol force in Texas. `Lone Star Law' features the men and women of the Texas Game Wardens who protect more than a quarter-million square miles of deserts, lakes, piney woods, bayous, plains and coast in the second-largest state in the US. Whether rushing to investigate poaching cases, save flash-flood victims, disrupt illegal smuggling rings, or rescue injured wildlife, the officers are always on the go, defending both animals and citizens.

Jeff Young has 80,000 friends in Denver, Colorado. That's about the number of clients - people and their pets - he serves as the popular owner/lead veterinarian of Planned Pethood Plus, one of the busiest animal clinics in the U.S. This poignant series reveals some of the riveting cases that Dr Jeff and his team of 30 veterinary experts respond to with precision, compassion and speed in an often tense, chaotic atmosphere. The staff juggle routine pet visits with several dozen daily crucial surgeries and emergencies. People who know and work with Pete Nelson describe him as a tree whisperer. For his part, Nelson lets the trees do the talking. He's a world-renowned treehouse designer and builder, and this series documents the work he and his team of craftsmen - including his son Charlie - do to create incredible homes and businesses in nature's canopy. Pete uses a combination of science and art to realize clients' sky-high aspirations of magnificent multibedroom treehouses with elaborate kitchens and bathrooms, or simpler, peaceful one-room escapes. British actor Richard E. Grant presents a natural history series focusing on the seven deadly sins and their presence in human and animal behaviour. The history of the capital vices is explored through their use in the literature of noted writers such as Dante Alighieri and William Shakespeare. As well as Grant viewing the sins from a human perspective, scientists identify these traits within the animal kingdom and apply them to what they believe are survival instincts. Episodes show wildlife footage of envious lions and wrathful hippopotamuses in action.

The breathtaking beauty of Alaska sometimes hides the fact its winters can be incredibly harsh, especially for those who live in the state's outlying areas. `Alaska: The Last Frontier' perfectly illustrates this reality, as the programme profiles life for the Kilcher family in the isolated community of Homer. For four generations the Kilchers have lived off what their 600-acre homestead has provided, but cultivating that living is never easy. Led by patriarch Atz Kilcher and his brother Otto, the family spends the short summer and fall gardening, hunting and fishing for food, gathering supplies from the land and preparing their animals for the winter. The channel says they are so far removed from civilization that they often go six to nine months each year without seeing an outsider. They refer to themselves as a "wolf pack" and, perhaps due to isolation, have their own accent and dialect. Die Sendung geht den Fragen auf den Grund, ob es Gott gibt und ob man Gott erfahren kann. Erzählt werden spannende, berührende und unglaubliche Geschichten von Menschen, deren Leben durch eine Begegnung mit Gott auf den Kopf gestellt wurde.

In dieser Folge wird am Herd ein festlicher Hackbraten mit Kirschsauce zubereitet. Das klingt im ersten Moment vielleicht etwas seltsam, aber Kirschen in der Bratensoße sind sehr lecker. Die Kirschen geben eine zusätzliche fruchtige Note.

Die Oma weiß am besten, was zum Kaffee schmeckt. In dieser Sendung lernt man nicht nur, wie man einen echten Zwetschgendatschi mit selbstgemachten Streuseln macht, sondern auch welcher Kaffee am besten dazu passt, um alles Gästen zu servieren.
Gezeigt werden die "Kraftvoll Leben"-Gottesdienste, die zu einem Leben mit Gott einladen.

Surveillance videos expose a landlady's bad behaviour, and a man says he was defending himself when he punched a female friend in the face.

pr.d: Official crime figures indicate violent crime is falling. So why do so many people feel less safe than ever? Ellie Flynn goes undercover to explore the anti-social behaviour plaguing communities nationwide.

Some extra brunch as Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer host the food and chat show.

pr.t: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
pr.d: In Woodford, London, Keeley and Terence's family of five are bursting out of their three-bed, one-bath house. Terence, however, loves the location, the local schools, the nearby transport links and their neighbours.

Woody is excited to get his first leading role at his theatre group, but he has trouble committing to a kissing scene because he doesn't want to feel like he's cheating on his girlfriend. Meanwhile, Sam, Cliff, Norm and Frasier have a beard contest.
Rebecca is afraid that Robin is getting tired of her since after four dates they have not yet slept together. To spice up their relationship, she decides to wait for him in his flat stark naked.
Doug quits his job at IPS because he's feeling unappreciated while Carrie goes overboard with the tanning lotion.
When a colleague of Carrie's shows an interest in Kelly, Doug and Carrie quarrel over whether to allow them to go on a date.
While on a short stop-over at Kennedy Airport, Doug's parents summon him over to make an unusual request. His sister Stephanie is offended that she wasn't the one asked.
Debra becomes angry when Ray contributes $1,000 to his friends hair-brained scheme to open a go-cart business without first consulting her.

Marie gathers Robert's ex-girlfriends Amy and Stefania and his female police partner together so they can dissect his character in an effort to understand why her eldest son can't commit to a relationship.
When Ray realises that his kids would rather spend time with their Uncle Robert than with him, he decides to do something about the situation.
Niles brings Daphne's hard-drinking dad from England to Seattle in hopes he'll reconcile with his wife, and Frasier obsesses about getting a good report card from his latest romantic partner.

Niles and Daphne marry on an impulse while on holiday in Reno, but are forced to hide their good news on returning to Seattle after learning that Frasier, Martin and Daphne's mother will all be heartbroken if they ever miss the couple's wedding.

Frasier and Niles are pitted against the owner of a local garage in a battle over principles and two dollars, while Daphne leaves the Crane household for the final time, and quickly realises just how much she's going to be missed by Martin and Eddie.

Frasier's attempts to become condominium president take a new turn when he persuades Martin to run as a 'puppet' candidate who, naturally enough, will receive his full backing. However, Martin quickly rumbles his scheming son's game, and decides to run his own campaign.

Ramsay tries to help the owner of Iberville Cuisine & Oyster Bar, located in the heart of the French Quarter. They want to be reinvigorated before Super Bowl LIX kicks off in the city's Caesars Superdome.
pr.sub: Road to Super Bowl LIX: Iberville

Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Jo Good in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.

Robbie continues to weave his mysterious plans as the family celebrate Mike's birthday, and Robbie and Angela can't deny their attraction any longer. And Sheila desparately tries to warn the Gartons.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Wing Commander Skins is on a routine patrol over Iraq when he sees ballistic missiles streaking from Iran towards Israel. It's the opening of a war that will engulf the Middle East.

Gordon visits family-owned restaurant Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California. Within minutes of his arrival, Gordon is caught in the crossfire of an argument between owner Sam, his wife and their children, all of whom are feeling the pressure of working in the restaurant seven days a week.

Willie and Julie kick off this competition from the Cambridge area with their hearty menu. Day two sees healthy food options from sporty pair Jeavon and Steve, and finally it's Italian Rica's turn with the help of Lynne to cook a high-end meal.

pr.t: Lawless Britain? Undercover on the Streets: Dispatches
pr.d: Official crime figures indicate violent crime is falling. So why do so many people feel less safe than ever? Ellie Flynn goes undercover to explore the anti-social behaviour plaguing communities nationwide.

Every year in Ghana, dozens of women accused of using black magic are driven from their homes or even killed. Reporter Jamal Osman travels to northern Ghana to meet some of the women whose lives have been destroyed by these accusations.
Lian and Dave are searching for a holiday home in Spain's Almería Province to enjoy with their 13-year-old son Dominic. Ben Hillman lines up five impressive properties their £80,000 budget.
Some extra brunch as Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer host the food and chat show.

pr.t: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
pr.d: In Woodford, London, Keeley and Terence's family of five are bursting out of their three-bed, one-bath house. Terence, however, loves the location, the local schools, the nearby transport links and their neighbours.

Woody is excited to get his first leading role at his theatre group, but he has trouble committing to a kissing scene because he doesn't want to feel like he's cheating on his girlfriend. Meanwhile, Sam, Cliff, Norm and Frasier have a beard contest.
Rebecca is afraid that Robin is getting tired of her since after four dates they have not yet slept together. To spice up their relationship, she decides to wait for him in his flat stark naked.
Doug quits his job at IPS because he's feeling unappreciated while Carrie goes overboard with the tanning lotion.
When a colleague of Carrie's shows an interest in Kelly, Doug and Carrie quarrel over whether to allow them to go on a date.
While on a short stop-over at Kennedy Airport, Doug's parents summon him over to make an unusual request. His sister Stephanie is offended that she wasn't the one asked.
Debra becomes angry when Ray contributes $1,000 to his friends hair-brained scheme to open a go-cart business without first consulting her.

Marie gathers Robert's ex-girlfriends Amy and Stefania and his female police partner together so they can dissect his character in an effort to understand why her eldest son can't commit to a relationship.
When Ray realises that his kids would rather spend time with their Uncle Robert than with him, he decides to do something about the situation.
Niles brings Daphne's hard-drinking dad from England to Seattle in hopes he'll reconcile with his wife, and Frasier obsesses about getting a good report card from his latest romantic partner.

Niles and Daphne marry on an impulse while on holiday in Reno, but are forced to hide their good news on returning to Seattle after learning that Frasier, Martin and Daphne's mother will all be heartbroken if they ever miss the couple's wedding.

Frasier and Niles are pitted against the owner of a local garage in a battle over principles and two dollars, while Daphne leaves the Crane household for the final time, and quickly realises just how much she's going to be missed by Martin and Eddie.

Frasier's attempts to become condominium president take a new turn when he persuades Martin to run as a 'puppet' candidate who, naturally enough, will receive his full backing. However, Martin quickly rumbles his scheming son's game, and decides to run his own campaign.

Ramsay tries to help the owner of Iberville Cuisine & Oyster Bar, located in the heart of the French Quarter. They want to be reinvigorated before Super Bowl LIX kicks off in the city's Caesars Superdome.

pr.sub: The One With the Blind Dates

pr.d: Joey stumbles upon a way to impress a famous actor during an audition, Ross learns the identity of a long-ago mugger, and Chandler accepts an internship at a shoe company.

pr.sub: The One With the Boob Job

pr.d: When Chandler jokingly posts an outrageous biography about Ross on Ross' college alumni website, Ross retaliates in kind, sparking an internet war. pr.sub: The One With the Memorial Service

pr.d: Hoping to win a huge jackpot, the friends pool their money and buy dozens of lottery tickets, but they argue over how to spend the fortune if they win, and Monica irritates everyone else by buying tickets just for her and Chandler. Exasperated, Phoebe takes the bowl of everyone's tickets and threatens to throw it off the balcony. The others make up, but a pigeon startles Phoebe.
A visit to the set of a soap opera inspires Rachel to dream of a romantic encounter with Joey, and Chandler must take Ross on a weekend getaway after Monica is unable to take time off from work.

Ross is excited when he meets a stunning palaeontology professor, but when he takes her to Joey's rooftop party for the actor's soap-opera co-stars, she intimidates him with her impressive list of former boyfriends. Meanwhile, Rachel and an intoxicated Monica make fools of themselves at the party chasing after the hunky daytime actors.
pr.sub: The One With the Soap Opera Party

pr.d: Monica and Chandler have an embarrassing encounter with an old acquaintance at a fertility clinic, Ross plays Cyrano to help Joey woo a professor, and Rachel sneaks into a spa for a massage hoping Phoebe won't find out.
pr.sub: The One With the Fertility Test

pr.d: Disappointed to learn that they cannot conceive a baby naturally, Monica and Chandler consider their options. When Chandler invites a handsome colleague round for dinner, Monica and Chandler embarrassingly interview him as a potential sperm donor. Meanwhile, while shopping with Phoebe, Rachel admits that she still has a thing for Joey.
The gang heads to Barbados for a palaeontology convention where Ross is the keynote speaker. Rachel harbours steamy thoughts about Joey while David prepares to propose to Phoebe.
In a race against the clock, Ross tries to get the gang dressed and ready for a black-tie benefit at the museum.
pr.sub: The One Where No One's Ready

pr.d: Monica decides the best way to get over Richard is to keep herself busy. She develops a 'jam plan', hoping the distraction of cooking will divert her attention. Elsewhere, Phoebe is mistakenly stalked by a man who thinks she's Ursula, and Chandler receives dating advice.

Pete journeys to the pine-forested splendour of Scandinavia to explore Norway's magical TreeTop Hotel and Sweden's floating Treehotel, with tree homes suspended by cables and accessed only by retractable ladders.
Pete goes behind the scenes with unseen footage, bloopers and lots of extra tree house tours, including a peek inside Dale Earnhardt Jr's arboreal escape.
The mining season is nearly over, and Rick Ness and his crew are making up for lost time. Plus, Tony goes off the beaten track in his search for gold.

Parker makes a big move to double his output and bring in more gold; the Beets face catastrophe when their only remaining operation grinds to a halt; just as Rick gets Monster Red dialled in, huge rocks threaten to shut him down for good.
The Browns face wild weather as they bring a haul to Port Alexander. The Integrity starts to show its age and the Browns get stranded in the middle of the water.
Skipper Phil Harris is airlifted to hospital in Anchorage and his son Josh is torn between catching the rest of their crab quota and his father's bedside.

When the Texas game wardens encounter a sick bald eagle, it becomes a race against time to ensure its survival; while checking deer camps near the border of Mexico, a warden finds himself in a high-stakes foot pursuit.

Game wardens patrol the Rio Grande in search of an unidentified body; Warden Powell investigates an unusual deer case; Wardens Boone and Ataya respond to a call about mountain lions being shot in a woman's backyard.
How do they make some of the world's smoothest writing ballpoint pens that don't leak or fade? And, how do they make pizza for soldiers on the frontline?
pr.sub: Ballpoint Pens, Army Rations and Rush Mats

pr.d: How do the islanders of the Outer Hebrides use pedal power to weave world-famous Harris tweed? And, in Iceland, how do they prepare fermented shark?
How is Parma ham, the most famous ham in the world, made? Plus, how do they make rowing machines, and how are the iconic London Underground signs made?
pr.sub: Parma Ham, Underground Signs and Rowing Machines

pr.d: How do they produce almost all of America's raisins in California's San Joaquin Valley? Plus, how do they make the world's oldest type of paper?

In order to save a Georgia homestead drowning in a snake and gator-infested swamp, the Raneys must find an ingenious way to reclaim the Buchannans' land from the encroaching mire and all it brings with it.

The boys set their sights on Mexico where Beetle fanatic Elvis wants to build a jacked-up Baja Bug for racing across sand dunes. But with just five days to complete the build and costs racking up Mike's worried Elvis may be getting carried away.

The boys head to São Paulo to buy the Brazilian designed VW SP2. It is a dream for Mike, but the car hopelessly lacks in power and with a drag race beckoning, Elvis needs to work his magic and give their SP2 the brawn to match its beauty.
Tizzy investigates complaints of a serial tip jar thief. A woman goes on a tirade in a car park, and the police sort out a cyclist's accusations against a young motorist.

A man runs away from Mimmi at Arlanda, as he is in possession of an item he is not allowed to keep. The customs service in Scania finds a suspicious object inside a container that is on its way to Russia.

Josh Gates explores the alleged curse behind King Tut's tomb explorers' deaths, the Dyatlov Pass incident where nine hikers died mysteriously and an influencer's disappearance in the Nevada desert, investigating potential supernatural links.

Minnies Pläne für einen Ausflug in die Schweizer Alpen werden von einer Familie aus Hawaii gestört.

Alice übertreibt es beim Kochen mit einer besonderen Zutat und alles geht schief, als sie einen Leckerbissen für die Babyknospen kochen will. Rosa will ihren ersten Campingausflug machen, doch der geht schief, als die Wächter ihr folgen.
pr.sub: Kuchen für die Röschen; Königliches Campen

pr.d: Micky und seine Freunde feiern den Hotdog-Tag ausgiebig.

Bingo ist völlig davon überzeugt, dass der Osterhase sie wie im vergangenen Jahr vergessen hat. Bluey findet daraufhin allerdings eine Reihe von Hinweisen, die sie auf eine großartige Schatzsuche mit zahlreichen Ostereiern führen.
Bluey und Mackenzie freuen sich darauf, Zeit mit ihren Freunden Mia und Captain zu verbringen.
Bluey freut sich auf ihr eigenes Zimmer. Doch als Schlafenszeit ist, vermisst sie Bingo.

Als Mama einen Hindernisparcours im Garten lediglich zum Spaß an der Sache einrichtet, will Papa ein Rennen veranstalten. Dementsprechend haben die Kinder nun Mut geschlossen, um mit allen Mitteln als Gewinner herauszugehen.

pr.t: Iron Man und seine fantastischen Freunde
pr.d: Die Iron Friends genießen ihren Seifenblasentag, bis Ultron mit unzerplatzbaren Seifenblasen auftaucht. Zeitgleich begrüßt Thor die Freunde Tony und Riri in Asgard, während Loki heimlich Odins geflügelte Pferde in die Freiheit entlässt.
pr.sub: Einfach unzerploppbar!; Die geflügelten Pferde von Asgard

pr.d: Mithilfe von Magie will Zane seine Tanzschritte verbessern. Doch sein Zauber verwandelt sich recht bald in einen Fluch. Sofia hilft ihm aus der Patsche. Sofia und Layla wollen gemeinsam eine Parade leiten. Doch sie können sich auf nichts einigen.
pr.sub: Der Tippity Tap Tanz / Die Zauber-Zepter-Wirbel-Truppe

pr.d: Chiffen ist ganz aufgeregt, als er im Zauberwald ein geheimnisvolles Ei findet. Wem gehört es nur? Darly und Loomis helfen ihm, es zu seiner Mutter zurückzubringen, doch der Abschied fällt Chiffen schwer.
pr.sub: Chiffen und sein Küken; Alle für Klein-Muffelmotz

pr.d: J.D. und seine jungen Kollegen werden erstmals auch mit der negativen Seite des Ärztestandes konfrontiert, nämlich dem Tod eines Patienten. J.D. versucht vergeblich eine etwas ältere Frau zu einer lebensnotwendigen Dialysebehandlung zu überreden.

J.D. wird zunehmend auch von den älteren Ärzten akzeptiert. Damit muss er im krankenhausinternen Zwist zwischen Chefarzt Dr. Kelso und dessen Todfeind Dr. Cox Stellung beziehen. Ohne Unterstützung des Chefarztes hat man keine Chance auf Karriere.

Dr. Kelso nutzt seine Position als Chefarzt, um seinen verhassten Kollegen Dr. Cox zu beurlauben. Über dessen weiteres Schicksal soll nun der Aufsichtsrat abstimmen. Dafür reist auch Jordan Sullivan, die einflussreiche Tochter des Klinikgründers, an.

Das Team wird zu einem Brand in einem Wohnhaus gerufen. Es besteht äußerste Gefahr, da sich eine hochexplosive Rauchwolke gebildet hat, die zuerst beseitigt werden muss. Am Dach des Hauses kommt es zu einer Auseinandersetzung zwischen Andy und Jack.

Andy und Jack geraten erneut aneinander. Es geht um die Ausgaben der Feuerwache. Noch vor der großen Eröffnung einer neuen Pension gerät die Küche in Brand. Zudem entdeckt Ryan per Zufall, dass Mayas Bruder in der Klemme steckt.

Jay veranstaltet eine große Party zum Super Bowl. Zur gleichen Zeit lädt Claire zu einer Babyparty für die schwangere Haley, die ebenfalls in Jays Haus stattfinden soll. Konflikte sind da natürlich bereits vorprogrammiert.

In ihrer Entwicklung zu einer jungen Frau erreicht Lily einen Meilenstein. Doch Cam und Mitch sind darauf überhaupt nicht vorbereitet. Sie fordern für Lilys Aufklärung weibliche Unterstützung an. Claire, Gloria, Haley und Alex eilen zur Hilfe.

Ein Vogelbaby verwechselt Bentley mit seiner Mutter und folgt ihm auf Schritt und Tritt. Bentley beschließt dann, sich darum zu kümmern und hat fortan nichts anderes im Kopf. Während er das Chalet kindersicher macht, reißt Taffy der Geduldsfaden.

Taffy und Bentley liefern sich die übliche Verfolgungsjagd, aus der Bentley ziemlich zerrupft und mit etwas Schaum vor dem Mund hervorgeht. Zu seinem Pech sieht Bentley nun wie ein Werwolf aus und Taffy schickt ihn hinterlistig zu Mrs. Münzberg.

Mrs. Münzbergs Schwester ist mit ihrem Hund Bradley in der Villa zu Besuch. Bradley ist Bentleys kleiner Neffe, der seinen Onkel über alle Maßen verehrt. Denn Bradley hat viele Geschichten darüber gehört, wie Bentley tapfer gegen Taffy kämpft.
Nach vielen Herausforderungen bekommt Beni eine neue: Er soll sich unsterblich machen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinettes Großmutter wird akumatisiert. Als Befana will sie sich nun an Marinette rächen, die ihre Zeit lieber mit ihren Freunden als mit ihrer Großmutter verbringt. Ladybug muss sich entscheiden, gegen ihre eigene Großmutter anzutreten.

pr.t: Mystery Lane - Ein Fall für Clever und Bro
pr.d: Gerüchten zufolge gibt es hinter der Brücke im Lexington Park einen versteckten Ort.
Eine mysteriöse Kapsel fällt in den Garten von Phineas und Ferb: ein Modell-Sonnensystem.

Bei einer Show im Big Coffee versucht sich Tilly im Bauchreden, doch Cricket fürchtet sich sehr vor ihrer Puppe. Im Park beobachten die Greens Spaziergänger, über die sie sich spannende und lustige Geschichten einfallen lassen.
pr.sub: Die Talentshow; Das Leben der anderen

pr.d: Bluey und Bingo haben fünf Minuten Wartezeit vor einem Restaurant zu überbrücken. Bis das Essen zum Mitnehmen fertig ist, suchen Bluey und Bingo nach immer neuer Ablenkung und fordern die Geduld ihres Vaters ganz schön heraus.
Schmetterlinge im Hinterhof zu spielen macht riesigen Spaß, bis Bluey mit Judo davonläuft.

In der Schule beschäftigen sich Bluey und ihre Freunde mit verschiedenen Spielen. Lehrerin Calypso stellt dabei eine Verbindung zwischen den Spielwelten der anderen her und alle tauchen mit ein - alle außer der mysteriösen Pretzel.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Herr Damokles, der Schuldirektor, wird zur Schwarzen Eule akumatisiert. Ausgerüstet mit Hochleistungsapparaten möchte er sich an Ladybug und Cat Noir rächen, da sie ihn gedemütigt haben. Die Helden müssen sein Gefieder zerzausen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Weil Chloé vergisst, ein Geschenk für Madame Bustier zu besorgen, verunstaltet diese aus Wut Marinettes Geschenk. Madame Bustier bittet Marinette daraufhin um Verzeihung. Hawk Moth nutzt Madame Bustiers Gutmütigkeit aus.

Miranda Bailey besucht Ben bei der Arbeit und trifft zum ersten Mal seine neuen Mitarbeiter. Der Großteil des Teams hat mit einem Autounfall zu tun. Andy und Maya tun sich zusammen, um auf ihre erste Überwachung zu gehen.

Andy, Jack und 18 weitere Kandidaten machen den Test, um Kapitän zu werden. Travis dient dabei als amtierender Kapitän, während Andy und Jack für den Tag weg sind. Ben konfrontiert Vic in der Zwischenzeit mit ihren Ängsten.

J.D. ist der Star unter den Assistenzärzten. Er ist kompetent, beliebt und Elliot zeigt zunehmend Interesse an ihm. Seine Position wird ihm jedoch von Nick, einem Neuankömmling, streitig gemacht. Sofort will J.D. gegen den Konkurrenten ankämpfen. Nick macht es ihm mit seiner zuvorkommenden Art jedoch schwer, gemein zu sein. Turk hat ganz andere Probleme. Er streitet mit Dr. Kelso um eine Parkbank, die sich wunderbar für eine Mittagspause eignet.

J.D. und Turk sind zufällig zur Stelle, als der Kameramann eines Fernsehteams einen Kreislaufkollaps erleidet. Sofort helfen sie dem Erkrankten und finden sich umgehend als die Helden des Tages in den Medien und im Krankenhaus wieder.

J.D. hat einen freien Tag. Die Gelegenheit will er nutzen, um sich zu amüsieren. Er besucht eine Party, auf der er Jennifer kennenlernt. Gerade als er sie ansprechen will, macht ihm eine Blinddarmentzündung einen Strich durch die Rechnung.

Scott Calvin, auch bekannt als Santa Clause, hat alle Hände voll zu tun: Nicht nur Weihnachten steht vor der Tür, sondern auch seine Schwiegereltern, die zur Geburt von Baby Santa angereist sind. Das Haus voller Familie, fällt es Santa ohnehin schon schwer genug, sein Versteck am Nordpol geheim zu halten. Zu allem Überfluss versucht der böse Jack Frost wieder einmal, Weihnachten an sich zu reißen.

Tony Baddingham stellt den Interviewer Declan O'Hara und den amerikanischen Produzenten Cameron Cook ein, um den Erfolg seines Fernsehsenders Corinium zu steigern. Der Umzug der O'Haras aufs Land bereitet Declan allerdings ein böses Erwachen.

Declan steht unter Druck, eine neue Erfolgsshow für Tony und seine Firma zu produzieren. Cameron hilft ihm dabei, obwohl die beiden ein gestörtes Verhältnis zueinander haben. Unterdessen versucht Tony, einen Geschäftsmann anzuwerben.

Dr. Jan Pol und Dr. Brenda sind im Stress: Zahlreiche Patienten warten bereits auf sie. Gleichzeitig müssen sich die beiden um das bevorstehende 30-jährige Betriebsjubiläum kümmern. Die Mitarbeiter sollen mit einem Spanferkel-Essen überrascht werden.

Als Frau verkleidet schließt Bobby sich unerkannt einer Tanztruppe an, um einen vermeintlichen Mädchenhändlerring hochgehen zu lassen. Quinnan refuses to speak to Page after her revelations regarding Liz. Whilst McAllister is dealing with a body that's been washed up from the river, Boyden is at the scene of a road accident. A lorry has come off the road and shed a couple of chest freezers. The holes in the freezers and an Iraqi paper inside the lorry lead Boyden to conclude that it was carrying illegal immigrants. Quinnan then spots four men walking along the roadside.
Simon is harassed by a patient and almost misses a life-threatening diagnosis, while Karen is out to impress at the family Christmas party.
Zara tries to get to the bottom of an unusual claim when a university cleaner says she has been attacked by a zombie.
Elliot is feeling suicidal following the traumatic events of the day and news of his son's prison sentence - so a mysterious man takes him on a dream-like tour.

Ash struggles with his emotions when a patient refuses treatment due to her religious beliefs. Meanwhile, Big Mac has his first day as a healthcare assistant and works with Dixie to help a man reunite with his daughter.

Lola's health hangs in the balance after the accident. The police look set to arrest Phil for possession of stolen goods, but he blames someone else to ensure he is not caught.
Shirley decides it is time to find out who is responsible for sending Phil the anonymous letters. She is stunned when she realises that it could be someone close to home.
Rosemary offers Des the management job after Helen declines it. Danny's scheme for computer betting ends in frustration.
Danny and Des find themselves in trouble with Max. There's a mixed reaction to Jim's news about Scott's new tutor. Helen is upset that Rosemary did not offer Paul the job.
An idyllic Shakespeare walk soon turns to disaster when one of the walkers is murdered and Frank becomes the prime suspect.
When radio quiz "Up to You" comes to Kembleford, Father Brown suspects that one of the cast is responsible for their landlady's murder.
The Medfords come to the aid of local government, with predictable results.
There's excitement in the air as everyone is getting ready for the wedding. However, as the guests arrive at the pub, Glenda receives a call to say the bridegroom has done a runner.
pr.sub: How Not to Cry at Weddings

pr.d: Compo, Clegg, and Blamire go around town discussing life and death, and observe their fellow townspeople and their problems.

At the library, Blamire, Clegg, and Compo are thrown out by Mr Wainwright. Compo realises he has lost his key and, upon discovering the library is closed, the trio try to find Mr Wainwright. They find he has gone to a formal dinner dance, and now they have to find their way into the party.
At an exclusive wine tasting, host Raymond Bettane dies from a spiked drink. As the detectives question each of the guests, Mick makes a shocking discovery about Bettane's vintage wines.
Anais, Kylie and Hoana follow the mysterious money trail behind Maja's return to Queenstown, and Kincaid discovers that Anais has been stealing his files.

As Brian Lane struggles to control and conceal his desire to drink again, he finds the perfect refuge in a commune at the centre of the team's investigation into the death of a university student. The case also helps Gerry face up to his relationship with Emily, who's not spoken to him since she discovered the truth about the DNA test at Ricky Hanson's trial.
The gangster responsible for the bodies behind the walls in the Notting Hill house is still active and the unearthing of past events provokes more murders and an international turf war.
Psychology student Alesia is tired of meeting `boys' and hopes to meet a real man in the buff. After 200 dates all over the world, Louise is ready to meet her soulmate.

Programmes on the 'Box' include 'Bridgerton', 'The Piano', 'Britain's Got Talent', 'Inside No. 9', 'My Strange Addiction: Still Addicted?', 'Top of the Pops 1984', 'The War on Britain's Motorists: Dispatches', and 'This Morning'.
Bart accepts a dare that puts him in the hospital. To cover for himself and Homer, Bart claims he met Jesus in heaven.

Gregory forms a bond with one of his students, but the student's dad becomes jealous of their relationship and seeks a confrontation; Melissa suffers a fall but avoids receiving medical attention for the injury.
Claire and Phil battle to prove who's the brainiest when they meet Haley's super-smart boyfriend. Mitch's yoga break proves anything but peaceful.
Jay's worried when Gloria's ex rocks up looking alarmingly like Manny and Phil gets in a fix as he tries to pick the perfect present for Claire.
Desperate to impress her new boss, Haley tries to get Gloria to sell her salsa to NERP and a lifelong dream comes true for Cam.

Craig's grand plan for his wedding to Sofia was to combine his two great loves: her and beer. He threw an Oktoberfest-themed do, complete with short leather pants and steins full of lager. The pair relive the moments that led up to their big day.

Nathan was worried he'd made a grave mistake by planning a Mexican Day of the Dead wedding for demanding bride Jenna. Nathan, best man Kennedy, Jenna, and bridesmaid Lucy relive the big decisions that led to his frightful fiesta.

When their competitor releases a catchy ad, Claire and Jay scramble to shoot a commercial of their own. Phil, Luke and Manny try to take down a drone that a neighbour keeps using to spy on Gloria, and Andy is rushed to the hospital.
Jay agrees to sub in on Cam's bowling team, not knowing it's an all-gay league. Phil and Claire have an unexpectedly nice time with their neighbours, and Gloria and Mitch agree to go out with Haley.

A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.

In and around Nottingham, young lovebirds Gabz and Pete kick off the competition by cooking the food they fell in love eating together. They go up against Sushma and Gulab and country-dwelling partners John and Shaun.
Gordon heads to Arvada, Colorado, where husband-and-wife owners Randy and Alexa have allowed their Old Neighbourhood restaurant to fall into utter disrepair.

Gordon heads to Queens, New York, where he finds a family torn apart by the stress of running failing Greek restaurant Kati Allo. Husband and wife owners Manny and Christine are on the brink of divorce, and daughter Evelyn is caught in the middle.

A woman finds a plastic cockroach in her bowl of chips; videos featuring twins; a teen who thinks her tongue has fallen out of her mouth after dental surgery; a little girl hides under the table to prevent her mum from seeing her eat ice cream.
pr.sub: Prank You Very Much, Kids Getting Upset for Dumb Reasons, and Twins

pr.d: After Hilary appears in traffic court, part of her sentence includes several hours of community service at the Southside Free Clinic, where she meets handsome doctor Alec Hudson. Meanwhile, Jazz becomes a butler.

When Will comes down with tonsillitis, his family book him into hospital for surgery. He meets an 80-year-old stand-up comic whose jokes about death make Will so nervous that he decides to escape. Plus, Geoffrey's pending book worries the Banks family.
Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain; Bart gets in shape.
Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but his new relationship may destroy Springfield.

Adam decides to see the movie Willow instead of spending Mother's Day with Beverly. Barry tires of his status as the family's middle child.
The family go to a nursing home and there is no way out for Jay, Claire and Mitch when they get trapped in the basement. Things get awkward when Haley meets Arvin's parents.

Mitchell and Phil sneak out to comic book convention Hero-Con. Dressed up as their favourite `Clash of Swords' characters, everything is going well until Phil commits a fan faux pas. Joe's party is ruined when Donna throws a better bash next door.

Homer tries, but fails, to eat an old box of baking soda, losing a $50 bet with Bart. So, Bart and Milhouse go on a shopping spree and end up running Comic Book Guy's shop after he has a heart attack. While the boys transform the shop, the convalescing Comic Book Guy falls for a female Springfield resident just as sarcastic as he is.

Bringing the best in television.

Teleshopping
Peavey Electronics COO Courtland Gray goes undercover to learn more about how his audio empire operates.
When Vivint CEO Todd Pedersen goes undercover, he struggles with his fear of heights and the pressures of the job.

Newly-weds Anita and Terry plan to recreate their wedding day; menu and speeches included! Day two sees competitive foodies Flora and Chris put on a restaurant inspired meal, and last to host are proud Londoners Cecelia and Paul.
Engaged couple Anita and Cash get the ball rolling in north London, with a menu drawing on their Indian heritage. Joining them are Keith and his laid-back wife Maz, and foodies Dan and Les.

Former soldier Jason takes command of his military wedding to his future bride-to-be, Sacha. Having served in the army for 7 years, Jason wants to celebrate the heroes of WW2 by getting Sacha to arrive to her wedding in an old warplane, then a tank.

Jacquie feels self-conscious about her looks and is dreaming of a small, elegant traditional wedding. Her fiancé Darren intends on making her his leading lady by throwing her into the spotlight with an amazing movie premiere inspired wedding.
pr.sub: The One with the Movie Premiere

pr.d: Ivy confuses profit with prophet, but still manages to climb his way to success. Kenny tries to honour the history of San Bernardino, recording a win along the way. Brandi shows her literary prowess volume by volume.

It's a regular father and son shootout in Victorville, as Ivy and Pops try to prove who among them is the most profitable. Brandi's secret weapon lands her more than she bargained for but luckily, Kenny is there to brighten her day.
The bosses of Hamburger Mary's go undercover and meet an employee who is so consumed with making money that respect for customers goes out the window.
United Real Estate Group CEO Dan Duffy goes undercover as a real estate agent, land appraisal specialist, interior decorator and auctioneer.
Hilarious clips include a litter of cat catastrophes and dog disasters.
pr.sub: Cat Catastophes, Dog Disasters, and the $100,000 Competition

pr.d: A small animal catches Lisa off guard, though she does snag a new type of prize; Ivy and Isaiah barrel their way through a unit, leaving them in need of a drink; Darrell keeps getting stuck behind an old lady.
Kenny tries to bribe the competition in Canyon Country and becomes more worldly as a result; Ivy and Isaiah make the most of their purchase; Brandi takes on the powers of darkness.

Ben's mistake leaves the guests and crew stranded on a remote beach in a storm. A new deckhand arrives and has many on board swooning. Sunny's insecurities threaten to ruin her relationship with Ben. And Fraser shares a kiss with one of the crew.
Gordon Ramsay is back in Redondo Beach, California, for the conclusion of his challenge to save Zayna Flaming Grill from imploding, and he still faces more questions than answers.
Gordon Ramsay is in Easton, Pennsylvania, to visit struggling Italian restaurant Bella Luna. Rosaria bought the establishment to realise her son Gianfranco's ambition to become a chef.
Jimmy Carr hosts as Sean Lock and Daisy May Cooper take on Richard Ayoade and Ivo Graham. Adam Buxton joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner and Joe Wilkinson assists Rachel Riley.

Jimmy Carr hosts the classic words and numbers quiz as Sean Lock and Harry Hill take on Jon Richardson and Rose Matafeo, while Alex Horne joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner. Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters.
The contestants have a mountain to climb as they must find a way to prove they can handle some teamwork. Morgana Robinson inspects suspect doggy bags and Guz Khan slaps a space hopper.
Psychology student Alesia is tired of dating 'boys' and hopes to meet a real man in the buff. And after 200 dates all over the world, Louise is ready to meet her soulmate.
On the 'Box: Bridgerton, Britain's Got Talent, Inside No. 9, My Strange Addiction: Still Addicted?, Top of the Pops 1984, and The War on Britain's Motorists: Dispatches.
Bart's Not Dead: Bart takes a dare that lands him in a coma. To get out of trouble, he says he went to heaven and saw Jesus.
Brand new series - Dad Fight: When Gregory bonds with one of his students, the child's dad becomes jealous of their relationship. And Melissa refuses medical help after a fall.
Royal Visit: When Haley's astrophysicist boyfriend visits, Claire and Phil compete to prove who's smarter. Mitch and Cam go to a yoga retreat.
Daddy Issues: Gloria's ex-boyfriend Jorge's resemblance to Manny makes Jay question if he might be Manny's real dad. Phil agonises over getting an anniversary gift for Claire.
Chips and Salsa: When Haley hears that her boss is looking for a product with the magical properties of peppers, she tries to convince Gloria to sell her salsa.
Craig's grand plan for his wedding to Sofia was to combine his two great loves: her and beer. So what did Sofia think of her Oktoberfest-themed wedding?
Nathan was worried his Mexican Day of the Dead-themed wedding would scare off bride Jenna. Did his do leave her wedding-day dreams dead at the altar?
Closet? You'll Love It!: Jay and Claire scramble to shoot a Pritchett Closets commercial in response to their competitor's new advert, but there might be some creative conflict.
Knock 'em Down: Jay agrees to join Cam's bowling team for the finals, but doesn't realise that he's not eligible to play in the league.
A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.
In and around Nottingham, there's amusing relationship advice, strong opinions, a traditional Indian banquet and a home-grown menu, as three couples put their hosting skills to the test.
Old Neighborhood: Gordon visits Arvada in Colorado, where out-of-control hoarder Randy and his wife Alexa have allowed their restaurant Old Neighborhood to fall into disrepair.
Kati Allo: Gordon's in New York, where the stress of running a Greek restaurant has driven Manny and Christine to the brink of divorce, with their daughter stuck in the middle.
Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments. A little girl doesn't want to grow up... because she doesn't want to eat salad!
Community Action: Thanks to her many traffic violations, Hilary is ordered to do community service at a medical clinic, where she immediately falls in love with the doctor.
Ill Will: While he's in hospital for a tonsillectomy, Will learns to look at life a little differently from his wisecracking wardmate, Max (guest star Milton Berle).
Lisa's Belly: Bart and Lisa have to take steroids after getting an infection at a waterpark - and the new drugs have some alarming side effects, particularly for Lisa.
Portrait of a Lackey on Fire: Smithers tires of Mr Burns' indifference and finds solace in the arms of affectionate fashion designer Michael de Graaf.
Mothers and Other Strangers: Homer does therapy to cope with missing his mother, sending him on a trip down memory lane, to when he and Grampa went on a road trip to find her.
A Made Maggie: Marge sends Homer to find a godfather for an as-yet-unbaptised Maggie. And who'd make a better godfather than mafia don Fat Tony?
I Lost on Jeopardy!: Erica applies to be on TV quiz show Jeopardy! A new crush makes Barry realise that he might not be quite over Lainey yet.
Mom Trumps Willow: Adam decides to see the movie Willow instead of spending Mother's Day with Beverly. Barry is tired of being the middle child.
The Escape: Haley meets Arvin's parents, but when things don't go as planned, fate leads to an unexpected reunion with all her ex-boyfriends.
Clash of Swords: Mitchell and fanboy Phil sneak out to Hero-Con in Clash of Swords cosplay. Gloria's dinosaur party for Joe is ruined.
I Love a Parade: The Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan set off more than a few fireworks at the Fourth of July parade, where Jay's the grand marshal.
Kiss and Tell: Haley asks Mitch and Cam for advice about whether she should tell Arvin about her kiss with Dylan. And Gloria suspects that Manny's Canadian girlfriend isn't real.
From Russia Without Love: Bart orders a Russian bride for Moe. She turns Moe's life around, and he falls in love.
Daddicus Finch: Lisa reads To Kill a Mockingbird and begins to observe wonderful similarities between Homer and Atticus Finch.
Werking Mom: Marge becomes a successful Tupperware salesperson and Lisa tries to do secret good deeds for people.
Krusty the Clown: Homer becomes a TV critic. Krusty joins the circus.
Worst Episode Ever: Bart and Milhouse end up running Comic Book Guy's shop after he has a heart attack. And, while he recovers, Comic Book Guy falls in love...
Brand new series - The Deli: When the local deli is forced to close to make way for a trendy smoothie place, Melissa, Barbara and Jacob fight back against gentrification.
That's No Lady, That's My Cousin: Vivian and Phil reveal their pregnancy news to Will, Carlton, Hilary and Ashley. And Ashley transforms her image to attract boys at school.
Hilary Gets a Job: A lecherous producer hires Hilary as his new weather presenter, but Will interrupts her first broadcast.
What do Britain's sharpest armchair critics think of Slow Horses, Dating Naked, Celebrity Race Across the World and more?
Roll-neck-phobe Lucy returns, and this time men are off the menu. Can Dr Nick cure GP Emma's dating dry patch? And will James's love of 1D send Mark in the direction of the door?

Divertida proposta en que dúas nais, con estilos de vida opostos, intercambiarán o seu fogar durante unha semana. Ao final da semana, as dúas familias enfróntanse para expoñer as súas diferenzas no seu modo de organizar a vivenda.

Coñecemos a Wang, procedente de Luoyang, que vive en Ourense. Despois visitamos a Walter, un dos mellores fabricantes de táboas de surf de toda Galicia. Por último, coñecemos a Joao, coordinador do Club de Atletismo de Santiago.

Cada semana daremos un paseo pola nosa terra visitando os lugares e veciños máis descoñecidos, os máis simpáticos, os máis característicos e os máis sorprendentes, uns destinatarios moi especiais que teñen moito que contar sobre Galicia.

For the 80th anniversary of Britain's darkest hour Dan Snow visits the House of Commons to learn about the speeches that turned the tide of WWII.

pr.t: The Forgotten Battle of World War I
pr.d: Learn how Belgium defended Liège forts as forces mobilised against a WWI threat.
Renowned historians explore how Hitler's rise to dictatorship in the 1930s was shaped by key events, supporters, and public sentiment in a rich, sophisticated and technologically advanced Germany.

pr.t: World War II: Saving the Reality
pr.d: Kenneth W Rendell's collection of World War II memorabilia features more than 6,000 original artefacts, including propaganda posters, French Resistance clothing, a Japanese admiral's uniform and a Sherman tank.
Technological innovations in U.S. naval aviation change the face of war.
Technological innovations in U.S. Navy aviation change the face of war.
The triumphs of the Prime Minister who led England through its darkest hour and on to victory.

By early 1944, Hitler had long been expecting an Allied attack on north-western France, but his problem was knowing when and where it would come. This episode has a look at the Allied operations Bodyguard and Overlord.
Concentrates on Hitler's attempts to shift the balance of power back in his favour.
The war in the Pacific against Japan was a savage hand-to-hand, island-to-island struggle, fought by new specialist fighting units like the valiant Chindits.
Allied forces converge on Germany, uncovering the horrors of Belsen and Buchenwald, before pushing towards Berlin, where Adolf Hitler is clinging to power in his last desperate days.
With Germany finally beaten, the Allies have now turned their attention to Japan, who made them pay for every inch of gained ground. Find out how this last, great foe was overcome.
For the 80th anniversary of Britain's darkest hour Dan Snow visits the House of Commons to learn about the speeches that turned the tide of WWII.

pr.t: Walking With Churchill with Andrew Roberts
pr.d: Andrew Roberts shares a selection of items from his Winston Churchill collection, documenting the fascinating life of one of Britain's most iconic figures.
Why Churchill replaced Chamberlain, beat Halifax, and steered Britain through WWII's darkest hour.

pr.t: 5 Great Speeches By Allied Leaders On D-Day
pr.d: Many Allied political leaders and generals delivered remarkable speeches on D-Day, here are five of the greatest.
A look at the strategic decisions made by Hitler during the Battle of Britain, which led to Operation Barbarossa, and the Axis invasion of the Soviet Union.
The poor military decisions made by Hitler started to become clear by 1942. America got involved in the conflict as a reaction to his declaration of war, as they made ground in North Africa.
Insight into the Battle of Okinawa, the largest assault of the Pacific campaign.

In the darkest days of World War II in the Pacific, an elite British military team sought to facilitate espionage and sabotage behind enemy lines. This now famous group, the British Special Operations Executive or MI6, faced a critical obstacle.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Pre-Pearl Harbour, the US helped democracies and men joined the army to prepare for WW2 and Japan's threat.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1942 the US had victories in the Doolittle Raid, Coral Sea and Midway while the Nazi's were taking Europe.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Have a look at WW2 in 1943, where the battle turned against North Africa and plans were laid to bomb Germany.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1944, the US waged global war towards Rome and the Pacific, and 6 June marked the D-Day landings.
The Battle of the Bulge continued in 1945 and the US battled stiff resistance on Leyte and Iwo Jima.
He was one of the greatest generals the world has ever known. In just thirty-two years of life, Alexander the Great changed the course of civilisation forever.
King George V's death in 1936 was later revealed to have been hastened by his physician. What were his motives and did he also euthanise the King's sister?
Sordid speculation dogged the life of Prince Albert Victor - he was even a suspect in the 'Jack the Ripper' case. Discover the truth here.
pr.sub: Albert Victor: The Prince and the Ripper

pr.d: A recurring mine marker points the team east to neighbouring Harrison Lake as leads and legend line up; clues found in a 1950s article by an investigative reporter place a lost Spanish gold mine directly on Slumach's path.
pr.sub: The Journey to the Lost Mine

pr.d: Adam and Kru scour the Breakenridge landslide for evidence of Slumach's legendary lost gold at a lost Spanish mine east of the Pitt on Harrison Lake. Meanwhile, Taylor and cousin Rain Pierre find new information concerning Slumach's trial, death and burial.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.

Alice tells the story of Norman England by studying the history of Winchester, Britain's most Norman city. Alice attempts to storm a castle in chain mail, investigates the origins of modern surgery and tucks in to an appetising eel pie.

Dr Alice Roberts looks at some excavations that offer a different perspective on the Vikings. She searches in the Outer Hebrides and Orkney for early Viking settlements. The Viking chief's citadel reveals information about their way of life.

Professor Alice Roberts explores British history through the stories of individual towns. Alice examines Britain in wartime by looking at the coastal town of Dover, a town that found itself on the frontline in the struggle against Nazi Germany.

In the North, the remains of a Tudor house in Leicestershire were thought to be the childhood home of England's forgotten Queen, Lady Jane Grey. But when archaeologists excavate, they find more than they bargained for.

Find out how a lobster led archaeologists to the discovery of an 8,000-year-old Neolithic underwater settlement. Join a team at a secret location in Dorset as they excavate an Iron Age crouched burial and in London's East End, location reporter Naoise Mac Sweeney visits a modern construction site as it gives up the secrets of an Elizabethan playhouse.
From Ancient Egypt and the rule of the pharaohs to Anglo-Saxon England, uncover the origins of the curses surrounding the bust of Nefertiti, the Staffordshire Hoard, and more.

The hunt leads to Anglo-Saxon England, medieval Europe, China under its first Emperor, and Egypt when the pharaohs still ruled, where the origins of the curses surrounding the Staffordshire Hoard, Black Prince's Ruby, and more are uncovered.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the English Civil War through the history of Oxford, the city at the heart of a battle between an autocratic king and his rebellious parliament. Oxford became the power base for Charles I and his royalist supporters.

Professor Alice Roberts tells the story of Edwardian Britain by visiting Cardiff, which grew rich selling the coal that powered the Empire. Alice hears the stories of the Edwardian miners and their backbreaking and often dangerous work.

Andy embarks on an enchanting journey to a haunted bookshop once graced by Charles Dickens, investigates the captivating mystery of King John's missing bones, and delves into the intriguing rumours of Oliver Cromwell's deal with the devil.

Andy embarks on a journey back to Scotland, exploring Rosslyn Chapel and its intriguing connection to the Holy Grail. He meets Billy Kirkwood at a cave believed to house a legendary beast and uncovers the story of Scotland's most infamous witch.

Dr Alice Roberts goes in search of our elusive Stone Age ancestors. Along the way she visits the Channel island of Jersey where she meets a team of archaeologists hoping to shed new light on the much-maligned Neanderthals, and embarks on a kayak survey of the coastline looking for undiscovered sites hidden in the cliffs. At the Natural history museum Alice sees the dark side of our Ice Age ancestors lives.
Alice discovers things at Norwich Castle Museum which highlight facts about Tudor life, Anglo-Saxon childbirth rituals, and the Pompeii of the Bronze Age.

Situated high on a crag overlooking the river Forth, Stirling Castle has guarded the gateway to the Scottish Highlands for centuries. The residence of kings, armies and felons, its battle-scarred walls have witnessed savagery and chivalry, intrigue, alchemy, adultery and murder. Location filming, stunning aerial shots and reconstructions bring to life its turbulent history.

Dan Jones explores the turbulent history of Carrickfergus, one of the most ancient castles in Northern Ireland and a stronghold that holds the key to understanding the tempestuous relationship between Britain and Ireland.

Professor Alice Roberts explores British history through the stories of individual towns. Alice examines Britain in wartime by looking at the coastal town of Dover, a town that found itself on the frontline in the struggle against Nazi Germany.
Professor Alice Roberts explores the Georgian era in her hometown of Bristol, from architectural gems to the world's first chocolate factory, backstreet gin and the horror of the slave trade.
From an Anglo-Saxon burial ground to the caves of the Judean Desert and Siberia during the Ice Age, uncover the origins of the curses surrounding Sutton Hoo, Lyuba, and more.
From the time of the Knights Templar to pre-historic Spain, uncover the origins of the curses surrounding the Turin Shroud, the ancient Cave of Altamira, and a moving statue in the Manchester Museum.

Amanda and Dan discover the Georgian era. Dan finds out what lengths Georgians were willing to go to have protected sex, making his own animal intestine condom, while Amanda pulls back the covers on the most famous lesbian of the period, Anne Lister.

Sherry stellt Michael und Mike vor eine Herausforderung. Wer am besten für Weihnachten dekoriert. Die Familie gibt alles, um jedes Haus mit einem einzigartigen Thema zu schmücken, und sorgt dabei für jede Menge Überraschungen.

Emma Roberts schließt sich mit Jonathan und Drew zusammen, um ihre ehrenamtliche Tante Mela mit einer individuell gestalteten Küchentransformation zu überraschen. Nach einem Leben voller Wohltätigkeit soll Mela einen vielseitigen Raum bekommen.

Sarah Silverman tut sich mit Jonathan und Drew zusammen, um eine Renovierung für ihre beste Freundin durchzuführen. Sarah bringt die Witze und den Presslufthammer mit, um die Wohnräume in dem veralteten Reihenhaus ihrer Freundin aufzufrischen.
Amy und Jess wünschen sich für ihre beiden kleinen Kinder endlich mehr Platz. Dank einer Erbschaft können sie ihr beengtes Haus in Michigan gegen ein größeres Zuhause tauschen.

Nach dem Tod ihres Vaters will Tina endlich ihren Traum verwirklichen: ein Haus in South Carolina, in dem sie für immer bleiben kann. Mit 275.000 Dollar aus ihrem Erbe sucht sie gemeinsam mit David Bromstad rund um Myrtle Beach.

Ein Paar aus Florida knackt den höchsten Jackpot des Staates und gewinnt 15 Millionen Dollar. David Bromstad berät die Familie, die das Geld in eine Immobilie investieren möchte. Zuerst muss die Familie entscheiden, was genau sie sucht.

Marcie hat dank David Bromstad ihre Traumimmobilie auf Cape Cod gefunden. Seitdem hat sich in ihrem Leben einiges verändert. Marcie erklärt sich sogar bereit, ihr Haus gegen ein Ferienhaus im South Shore Corridor von Massachusetts einzutauschen.

Makler David Bromstad hilft neuen Lotto-Millionären beim Geldausgeben für ein Traumhaus. Viele stehen vor der ersten großen Investition in ihrem neuen Leben. Nicht immer fällt die Entscheidung für Luxus. Manche bleiben auch bescheiden.
pr.sub: Wenn der Urlaubsort zum Wohnort wird

pr.d: Die Geburtstagsfeier in Las Vegas endet mit einem satten Gewinn. Das Paar sucht ein Familienhaus am Rand der Stadt der Glücksspieler. Immobilienmakler David Bromstad hilft den Neu-Millionären bei der Suche nach einem passenden neuen Zuhause.

Caitlin und Zach wollen ein Haus, das perfekt auf die Bedürfnisse ihrer vierköpfigen Familie angepasst ist. Josh entwirft für sie eine revolutionäre Treppe, die gleichzeitig als versteckter Vorratsschrank dient und über eine Kindersicherung verfügt. Die kleinen Kinder des Paares bekommen ihr eigenes Etagenbett, das sich in der Wand versenken lässt, um einem Spielbereich Platz zu machen. Außerdem enthält das Haus eine Menge Stauraum und multifunktionale Besonderheiten.

Chrissys Anliegen ist es, den Planeten zu schützen. Daher will sie so viele recycelte Materialien wie möglich für ihr Minihaus in Burlington, Vermont, verwenden. Ihr Baumeister Seth hält nicht sehr viel von ihrer Idee wegen der Abnutzung solcher Materialien. Doch die beiden müssen sich einigen, um den Termin für Chrissys Einzug einhalten zu können, und vielleicht wird sie einige ihrer grünen Träume doch noch aufgeben müssen.

Cody und Alexia aus Texas heuern einen Baumeister an, der sich auf Minihäuser mit großem Wiederverkaufswert spezialisiert hat. Bo entwirft eine Loftetage, die sich toll als Babyzimmer eignet und den Wiederverkaufswert steigert, wenn das Baby größer ist. Das schöne Haus hat auch noch andere gut verkäufliche Merkmale wie einen maßgeschneiderten Kleiderschrank mit einer Treppe und eine normal große Küche.

Nachdem sie eine Nahtoderfahrung hatten, haben Joe und April beschlossen, dass die Zeit für eine Veränderung gekommen ist. Bruce und Bart entwerfen das perfekte Minihaus für die kleine Familie, bevor sie nach North Carolina umzieht. Das Haus wurde entworfen, um den Bedürfnissen jeden Familienmitglieds entgegenzukommen und hat eine Gourmetküche für den Profikoch Joe, schnörkelloses Design, das Aprils Geschmack entspricht, und viel Raum zum Spielen für ihre Tochter Sophie.

Die US-amerikanische Tanzlehrerin Andrea verlässt Ohio, um sich ein neues Leben in der tschechischen Hauptstadt Prag aufzubauen. Nun sucht sie nach einer schönen Wohnung in der historischen Altstadt. Kompromisse will sie keine eingehen.
Der Wunsch nach einem neuen Abenteuer bringt eine Familie nach Budapest. Das junge Paar stellt sein Leben auf den Kopf. Doch sie haben unterschiedliche Erwartungen an ihr neues Zuhause.

Eine junge Frau, die in Amerika lebt, sucht nach einem schönen neuen Zuhause in Budapest, um ihre Wurzeln dort wiederzuentdecken. Ihr Budget ist für Ungarn relativ hoch, doch auch dort ist der Immobilienmarkt stark umkämpft.

Norbert und Starr ziehen mit ihrer Tochter Skyla von Los Angeles nach Budapest, wo Norberts Familie ursprünglich herkommt. Die Familie sucht nach einem schönen Zuhause, in dem sie ihrer Kreativität freien Lauf lassen kann.

Tamara beschließt, aus Florida wegzuziehen, um sich nach ihrer Scheidung in der polnischen Hauptstadt Warschau ein neues Leben aufzubauen. Sie sucht nach einer zentral gelegenen Wohnung mit Platz im Freien für ihre Katze.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Carmen und ihre Tippgemeinschaft knacken den Jackpot. Für ihren Anteil in Höhe von 12,7 Millionen sucht sie mit ihrem Verlobten ihr Traumhaus in Tennessee. Sie will mindestens den Super-Duper-Luxus auf 300 Quadratmetern - und kann es sich leisten.
Ein Paar möchte unbedingt mit seinen Kleinkindern umziehen, ist von der Suche jedoch erschöpft.

Nach vier Umzügen in neun Jahren bereitet sich eine Familie darauf vor, ihr Stadthaus gegen ein maßgeschneidertes Zuhause für immer einzutauschen, was die Brüder dazu bringt, ihre ständig wachsende Wunschliste zu erfüllen.

Ein Paar sucht nach 20 Jahren zur Miete nach einem Eigenheim auf den Outer Banks in North Carolina. In der teuren Gegend soll das Haus am Meer liegen und über einen Gästebereich mit Bad verfügen, der für die Kinder und Enkel gedacht ist.

Adrienne und Steve sehnen sich nach einem Ferienhaus in St. Joe Beach in Florida, denn die weißen Sandstrände lassen den Ort unter anderem als ultimatives Feriengebiet gelten. Sie finden ein Haus, bei dem allerdings viel renoviert werden muss.

Ein Paar sucht in St. Mary's County in Maryland nach einem Wochenendhaus für die Familie, um dort mit ihren Töchtern die vielen verschiedenen Outdooraktivitäten genießen zu können. Ihr Freund und Makler Conor soll ihnen bei der Suche behilflich sein.

pr.t: Jenny & Dave: Alte Häuser, neuer Look
pr.d: Ryan und Mary leben seit zwei Jahren in einem seltenen Haus im holländischen Kolonialstil. Jetzt sollen Jenny und Dave das alte Haus in ein Traumhaus verwandeln, mit einer neuen, offenen Küche und einem unerwarteten Farbtupfer im Außenbereich.

pr.t: Jenny & Dave: Alte Häuser, neuer Look
pr.d: Die Besitzer einer Weinbar bewirten gerne auch privat Freunde und Bekannte. Doch der Grundriss ihres Hauses, instabile Balkone und ein riesiger, verrotteter Baum wirken nicht besonders einladend. Zum Glück sind Dave und Jenny zur Stelle.

pr.t: Jenny & Dave: Alte Häuser, neuer Look
pr.d: Jenny und Dave sollen das Haus einer Hobby-Bäckerin und ihres Mannes umgestalten. Das dunkle, verwinkelte Haus soll zu einem lichtdurchfluteten und einladenden Zuhause werden. Dave und Jenny gestalten die Fassade und das Innere des Hauses um.
Peter hilft Steve und Maria mit den Überresten ihres Lebens, die ihre Pergola im Freien vollstopfen.

Nachdem sie als Flüchtlinge in Australien angekommen sind, ziehen drei Schwestern aus dem Haus ihrer Familie aus und lassen ihre Unordnung zurück. Auf einer emotionalen Reise entdeckt diese Sendung ihre unerzählte Überlebensgeschichte.

Nach der Besichtigung von 24 außergewöhnlichen Häusern stehen die acht spektakulärsten Objekte im Finale. In mehreren Runden wird entschieden, welches Gebäude sich am Ende durchsetzt und als Zillow Gone Wild Champion gekürt wird.

Der Reporter startet seine Reise bei einem Haus in Form eines riesigen Schuhs. Anschließend besucht er ein autarkes Ökohaus abseits der Zivilisation und wirft einen Blick in das außergewöhnliche Refugium eines bekannten Songwriters. Es sind drei Häuser, die unterschiedlicher kaum sein könnten.

Jack erkundet weitere außergewöhnliche Häuser in den USA. Auf seiner Reise besucht er eine prunkvolle Villa mit eigenem Kino, ein Wohnhaus im Stil eines Bergwerks auf einem riesigen Grundstück und ein Berghaus mit Dschungel-Thema.

Jack setzt seine Suche nach den außergewöhnlichsten Häusern Amerikas fort. Diesmal entdeckt er ein Western-Anwesen mit besonderem Flair, ein fantasievolles Designerhaus und ein maritimes Traumhaus, die alle auf neue Eigentümer:innen warten.

Retta begibt sich auf eine Jagd entlang der Pazifikküste. Dabei besichtigt sie einen mit Linoleum bedeckten Albtraum, ein Haus mit einer Treppe direkt zur Hölle und ein drückend heißes Haus mit einem riesigen eingebauten Solarium.
Retta besucht eine kaputte Hütte mit einem Katzenproblem, eine staubige Kuppel und ein Haus.

Retta besucht die Großen Seen und findet eine Reihe hässlicher Häuser. Dort erhält sie einen genauen Blick auf ein echtes viktorianisches Puppenhaus, ein Haus am See mit einem seltsamen Geruch sowie eine ehemalige Kirche.

Nach einer Suche von Küste zu Küste gibt Retta bekannt, welches hässliche Haus im Paradies eine 150.000-Dollar-Verjüngungskur erhält. Die Designerin Alison Victoria übernimmt die komplette Sanierung und sorgt für eine lebensverändernde Veränderung.

Monte und Lisa aus Nashville, Tennessee, haben eine Million Dollar gewonnen und wollen ein großes Haus kaufen. Es soll genug Platz bieten, damit ihre fünf Kinder zu Besuch kommen können, und außerdem einen Pool und eine Männerhöhle haben.

A large semi in New Barnet in London is bought as an ambitious project to turn into a family home, a family do up a semi in Dover in Kent to make a profit, and two friends club together to try their hand at refurbishing a terraced house in Derby.

A large Victorian semi packed full of original features in Dresden in Stoke-on-Trent, a two-bed semi in Croydon in London and some public loos in Kincardine in Fife are sold at auction. Martin, Dion and Martel meet the new owners and hear their plans for their auction buys.
A huge 1930s house in Kidderminster, Worcestershire, a purpose-built flat in a 1980s block in Wembley, North London, and a substantial Victorian semi in Burslem, Staffordshire, are sold at auction.

A house in need of a total refurbishment in London's St John's Wood sells for well over a million pounds while a terrace in Birkenhead near Liverpool and a piece of land in Handsworth in Birmingham sell for much more modest sums. But all three projects require a lot of hard work from their new owners to make the best of their auction buys.

A mid-terrace house with period features in Forest Gate in London, a house with a stream but close to a railway line in Handsacre in Staffordshire, and a large three-storey property in Plymouth are all sold at auction.
A third-floor flat in Walworth in London, a piece of land in Derbyshire's Chesterfield, and a block of flats in Hengoed in Mid-Glamorgan are all sold under the hammer.

Martel Maxwell visits a house in Guildford, Martin Roberts falls in love with a Grade II-listed house in Torquay in Devon, and Dion Dublin is in Barry in Wales assessing all the work needed on a mid-terrace house. Will the developers' plans run smoothly?

Martel talks to a 20-year-old developer whose fourth property is in Madeley Heath, Dion meets two friends refurbishing a flat in Birkenhead, and Martin talks to identical twin brothers who have ambitious plans for a derelict fire station in Paisley.

A bungalow in Callington in Cornwall, a three-bed semi in Willenhall near Wolverhampton and a terraced house in Hertfordshire's Watford are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Martel meet the new owners, and hear their plans for their auction buys.

Lucy Alexander talks to experienced developers who deliver a stunning renovation on a subsidence-troubled semi in Coulsdon in Surrey, Dion Dublin meets two brothers with ambitious plans for a commercial property in Derby, and Martel Maxwell meets with two golfing friends turned developers who plan to turn round a one-bedroom flat in Telford in Shropshire in record time.

A two-bed detached house ripe for extending in Bilston near Wolverhampton, a cosy cottage in Nettlestead Green in Kent and a terraced house in Etruria in Stoke-on-Trent without a bathroom or an inside loo are all sold under the hammer.

A garage with development potential in Margate in Kent, a ground-floor flat in a Victorian house in Shepherd's Bush, London, and a piece of land ripe for building on in Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.
Martin and Lucy visit a derelict 200-year-old listed cottage in Cumbria, another cottage in Cornwall as well as a huge retail building in 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon.
Martin looks around terraced projects in Staffordshire and south Wales, while Lucy looks at a small, rundown detached cottage on a large plot with huge potential in Surrey.

An argument escalates into a street fight with bottles and fists flying.
